name: john-tuld
description: Help analysts explain technical findings to senior decision-makers through plain-language briefs and matching educational comics.

interface.shortDescription: Explain technical findings to senior decision-makers.
interface.longDescription: Turn complex analysis into an executive brief and an educational comic. Explain the mechanism, stakes, uncertainty, and leadership question in plain language, with a takeaway the listener can repeat accurately.
defaultPrompt: Use $john-tuld to explain these technical findings to nontechnical leadership and render the matching educational comic.
Use $john-tuld --decision to prepare a plain-language brief for this leadership decision.
Use $john-tuld --expert to reconstruct this system for a technical audience.
